contract: Surface: PROCTOR public website (static export, live reads from the testnet registry). Job: Let a judge or agent buyer verify PROCTOR is real and check whether a candidate holds a live certificate. Primary action: Check an agent (verdict from live registry reads, same rules as the MCP server). Hierarchy: Hero with live counts -> Test it in 5 minutes -> How it works -> Live registry (stamped certificate papers) -> Check an agent -> Trust model. Reference: Issuing-authority record aesthetic: paper and ink, mono hashes, colour reserved for certificate status (active/suspended/revoked).

accessibility.evidence: Lighthouse (chrome-devtools MCP) Accessibility 100 and Agentic Browsing 100 on desktop and mobile after fixing contrast (dimmed stages), a prohibited aria-label on SplitText and a malformed dl. Playwright: skip link is the first Tab stop and becomes visible; logical tab order with a solid focus outline on every stop; status shown as text as well as colour.

responsive.evidence: Playwright at 390x844: document scrollWidth equals clientWidth (375) with zero elements past the right edge after scrolling the whole page; commands wrap instead of scrolling; hero headline left-aligned. Desktop 1440x900 full-page capture reviewed.

loading.evidence: Registry and verdict areas render fixed-height skeletons (pulse disabled under reduced motion); hero counters show a placeholder dot while aria-busy is true.

empty.evidence: With no certificates the registry shows 'No certificates yet' and points to 'Test it in 5 minutes'; Check an agent shows a prompt before any input.

error.evidence: RPC failure shows a role=alert panel with the specific message and a Try again button, never guessed numbers; invalid candidate ids are rejected before any request ('Ids may only use letters, digits and . _ : / @ + -', verified in Playwright).

partial.evidence: Market handles get the registry verdict plus a labelled note that market track record is unavailable in browsers (the Agent Market API sends no CORS header), with a link to the agent's real page at /a/<handle>; verified for dailybriefer.

success.evidence: Live testnet data: hero shows 1 open exam, 3 sittings, 1 live certificate; certificate 0 renders with its real hashes; verdicts verified in Playwright: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash -> Hire, GPT-5.4 nano -> Do not hire, market dailybriefer -> Do not hire.

permission.reason: Every read is a public, keyless NEAR view call and the site has no accounts or gated content, so no permission boundary exists.
